intro: With phosphate mostly gone, Nauru relies on Australian payments and fishing licences.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Payments for hosting Australia's immigration centre, fishing licences and remaining phosphate are the main income. A trust fund aims to provide for the future.

chapters.title: Land rehabilitation
text: Plans aim to restore mined land for housing and farming.

cardGroups.title: Made in Nauru
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Nauru makes and sells to the world.
